# SmartZone

> SmartZone is a device repair workshop in Timaru, New Zealand.

## Official website

- https://smartzonenz.co.nz/
- Preferred business name: SmartZone
- Location: 257 Stafford Street, Timaru 7910, New Zealand
- Phone: +64 3 927 2312
- Opening hours shown on the website: daily, 9am-5pm

## Pages

- [Phone and device repair services](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/#services): overview of repairs and supported devices.
- [Screen repair in Timaru](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/screen-repair-timaru): screen fault diagnosis and repair information.
- [Phone battery replacement in Timaru](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/phone-battery-repair-timaru): battery issue and replacement information.
- [Water-damaged phone repair in Timaru](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/water-damage-phone-repair-timaru): safe first steps and assessment information.
- [Why choose SmartZone](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/why-choose-smartzone): workshop, service and repair policy information.
- [Contact and visit information](https://smartzonenz.co.nz/#visit): address, hours, phone and map.
